PaginationProps.name: boundaryCount

When `true` (the default), arrow-key navigation wraps from the last option
back to the first. Set `false` to stop at the ends.

RadioGroupProps.name: error

RatingProps.name: count

RatingProps.name: step

Granularity of the rating value. `1` for whole stars (default), `0.5` for
half stars.

RatingProps.name: size
RatingProps.description: Size of the rating. Defaults to `sm`.

RatingProps.name: icon
RatingProps.description: Star glyph; the component's content, so it is a prop + slot pair (P11).

TimePickerProps.name: interval

TimePickerProps.name: options
TimePickerProps.description: Caller-provided options; bypasses the generated grid.

TimePickerProps.name: typeable
TimePickerProps.description: Whether the input accepts typed times. Default: `true`.

TimePickerProps.name: keepOpen

TimePickerProps.name: openOnFocus
TimePickerProps.description: Opens the popover when the input receives focus. Default: `false`.

TreeRootProps.name: items

TreeRootProps.name: nodeKey

TreeRootProps.description: Fires with the selected values after a selection change.

TreeRootProps.name: onExpandedChange

TreeNodeProps.name: indexPath

AppSidebarProps.name: search
AppSidebarProps.description: Optional fixed control below the tenant and above the scrolling groups.

AppSidebarProps.description: Advanced navigation composition, still inside this single sidebar.

AuthCardProps.name: children
AuthCardProps.description: The form itself — fields and the submit button.

AuthCardProps.name: footer
AuthCardProps.description: The line under the form: "Don't have an account? Sign up".

CommandPaletteProps.name: shortcut
CommandPaletteProps.description:
Bind ⌘K / Ctrl+K. Default `true`; the listener only opens, never closes —
pressing it inside an open palette should feel like nothing happened rather
than like a toggle you cannot see.

CommandPaletteProps.name: label
CommandPaletteProps.description: Accessible name of both the dialog and the list. Default `Commands`.

CommandGroupProps.name: label
CommandGroupProps.description: Group heading; also the group's accessible name.

CommandItemProps.name: keywords
CommandItemProps.description: Extra search text for words that are not in the visible label.

DataTableProps.name: hideSearch
DataTableProps.description: Pages whose FilterBar owns search hide the table's own.

DataTableProps.name: selectable
DataTableProps.description: Selection checkboxes + bulk action. Default on; off for read tables.

DataTableProps.name: onClearFilters
DataTableProps.description: Empty-state reset for externally filtered pages (beats Clear search).

DetailHeaderProps.name: breadcrumbs
DetailHeaderProps.description: The trail above the title. Omitted → no breadcrumbs.

DetailHeaderProps.name: subtitle
DetailHeaderProps.description: Muted line under the title — a record id, an owner, a timestamp.

DetailHeaderProps.name: actions
DetailHeaderProps.description:
Trailing actions in order. Everything but the last renders as an outline
button; the last is the primary one.

DetailHeaderProps.name: children
DetailHeaderProps.description: Anything else on the trailing edge, before the actions.

FilterBarProps.name: query
FilterBarProps.description: Rendered as a search input. Omit for a bar with no query box.

FilterBarProps.name: selects
FilterBarProps.description: One or more selects, in order.

FilterBarProps.name: tabs
FilterBarProps.description: A segmented control on the trailing edge — the view switcher.

FilterBarProps.name: chips
FilterBarProps.description: Active filters restated as removable pills under the bar.

FilterBarProps.name: onClearAll
FilterBarProps.description:
Renders a "Clear all" button while a filter is active (a chip, a filled
select, or a non-empty query). The bar never clears anything itself —
it reports the request and the caller resets its own state.

FilterBarProps.name: resultCount
FilterBarProps.description: Rows the current filters match, stated under the bar (`24 results`).

FilterBarProps.name: children
FilterBarProps.description: Anything else on the trailing edge, after the tabs.

KanbanBoardProps.name: columns
KanbanBoardProps.description: Controlled columns. When given, the board never changes them itself.

KanbanBoardProps.name: defaultColumns
KanbanBoardProps.description: Uncontrolled initial columns. The board owns them from here.

KanbanBoardProps.name: onMove
KanbanBoardProps.description: Fires on every accepted drop, controlled or not.

KanbanBoardProps.name: children
KanbanBoardProps.description: The card body. The frame — grab, ghost, move menu — belongs to the block.

KanbanBoardProps.name: renderActions
KanbanBoardProps.description: Replaces the built-in "Move to…" menu on every card.

KanbanBoardProps.name: label
KanbanBoardProps.description: Accessible name for the board region.

KanbanBoardProps.name: itemLabel
KanbanBoardProps.description: How a card is named in its menu and its accessible name. Defaults to its id.

KanbanBoardProps.name: emptyColumn
KanbanBoardProps.description: Rendered in a column with no cards.

MobileNavProps.name: children
MobileNavProps.description: One or more `MobileNavItem`s, each becoming an equal-width tab.

MobileNavItemProps.name: label
MobileNavItemProps.description: Label under the glyph; also the accessible name.

MobileNavItemProps.name: icon
MobileNavItemProps.description: Lucide icon name or component (P11). Replaced by `children`.

MobileNavItemProps.name: route
MobileNavItemProps.description: In-app destination. Renders an anchor; wins over `href`.

MobileNavItemProps.name: href
MobileNavItemProps.description: External URL. Renders an anchor when `route` is absent.

MobileNavItemProps.name: active
MobileNavItemProps.description: Highlight this tab. A state prop, independent of the current route.

MobileNavItemProps.name: 'aria-current'
MobileNavItemProps.description: Marks the item as the current page for assistive tech.

MobileNavItemProps.name: children
MobileNavItemProps.description: Custom content in place of the icon — an avatar, a badge.

MobileNavItemProps.name: onClick
MobileNavItemProps.description: Click handler. Set it on button items, and on links to navigate in-app.

MobileNavItemProps.name: aria-current
MobileNavItemProps.description: Marks the item as the current page for assistive tech.

PageToolbarProps.name: menu
PageToolbarProps.description: Options for the ellipsis menu beside the title. Omitted → no menu.

PageToolbarProps.name: action
PageToolbarProps.description: The primary action — the one thing this screen is for.

PageToolbarProps.name: children
PageToolbarProps.description: Anything else on the trailing edge, after the primary action.

SettingsDialogProps.name: title
SettingsDialogProps.description: Accessible dialog title, rendered visually hidden. Defaults to `Settings`.

SettingsDialogProps.name: description
SettingsDialogProps.description: Accessible dialog description, rendered visually hidden.

SettingsNavGroupProps.name: label
SettingsNavGroupProps.description: Group heading shown above its items.

SettingsNavItemProps.name: value

SettingsNavItemProps.description:
Explicit selected state. Omit to derive it from the dialog's selected
`value`, which is the usual case.

SettingsPanelProps.name: value
SettingsPanelProps.description: Unique panel id — must match the `SettingsNavItem` that controls it.

SettingsHeaderProps.name: title
SettingsHeaderProps.description: Convenience heading. Omit and use `children` for a custom header.

SettingsHeaderProps.name: actions
SettingsHeaderProps.description: Actions on the right of the default title header.

SettingsRowProps.name: title
SettingsRowProps.description: Setting name, rendered on the left.

SettingsRowProps.name: description
SettingsRowProps.description: Optional helper text under the title.

SettingsRowProps.name: labelFor
SettingsRowProps.description: Explicit id to associate the title label with. Overrides auto-detection.

SidebarProps.name: collapsible
SidebarProps.description: Allows the sidebar to collapse. Default `true`.

SidebarProps.name: width
SidebarProps.description: Expanded width as a CSS length.

SidebarProps.name: collapsedWidth
SidebarProps.description: Collapsed width as a CSS length.

SidebarProps.name: collapsed
SidebarProps.description: Controlled collapsed state. Unset: collapses below the `sm` breakpoint.

SidebarProps.name: onCollapsedChange
SidebarProps.description: Fired on every user toggle, controlled or not.

SidebarProps.name: ariaLabel
SidebarProps.description: Accessible name of the `<nav>` landmark. Default `Main`.

SidebarProps.name: shortcut
SidebarProps.description:

editor-trained user tries first, and the one a collapsed rail is for.

SidebarHeaderProps.name: logo
SidebarHeaderProps.description: Leading logo: an image URL or a component.

SidebarHeaderProps.name: showLogo
SidebarHeaderProps.description: Render the leading logo/initial box. Default `true`.

SidebarLabelProps.name: divider
SidebarLabelProps.description:
While collapsed, swap the label for a horizontal divider so groups stay
visually separated.

SidebarLabelProps.name: action
SidebarLabelProps.description: Trailing control of the group row: sort, filter, add. Hidden in the rail.

SidebarItemProps.name: label
SidebarItemProps.description: Accessible name and tooltip while collapsed. Defaults to string children.

SidebarItemProps.name: icon
SidebarItemProps.description: Leading glyph when `prefix` is unset: a `lucide-*` string or a component.

SidebarItemProps.description:

over `href`. Renders an anchor with a plain `href`; pair it with `onClick`
to intercept the click and navigate with your router.

SidebarItemProps.name: href
SidebarItemProps.description: External URL, opened in a new tab unless `target` says otherwise.

SidebarSearchProps.name: hint
SidebarSearchProps.description:
Trailing slot inside the field — a `⌘K` hint, usually, so the shortcut is
discovered where the search is rather than in a menu.

SidebarTriggerProps.name: label
SidebarTriggerProps.description: Tooltip copy. Defaults to Collapse/Expand, per state.

SidebarSectionProps.name: label
SidebarSectionProps.description: Group heading. Omit for a heading-less group.

SidebarSectionProps.description: Makes the heading a disclosure that collapses the body.

SidebarSectionProps.name: collapsed

SidebarSectionProps.name: onCollapsedChange
SidebarSectionProps.description: Fired on every toggle, controlled or not.

SidebarCardProps.name: icon

StatGridProps.name: columns

VirtualListProps.name: overscan

VirtualListProps.description: One row's content; the `li` and its position belong to the list.
